Game Overview

Mouse Survivor puts players into a casual experience centered on guide a brave mouse through a vibrant, ever-changing 2D world where quick reflexes and strategic thinking are key. Dodge snakes, bombs, and twisting platforms while collecting cheese to unlock new realms. Navigate thrilling landscapes filled with surprise obstacles and endless excitement.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Mouse Survivor is easy to pick up. Guide a brave mouse through a vibrant, ever-changing 2D world where quick reflexes and strategic thinking are key. Dodge snakes, bombs, and twisting platforms while collecting cheese to unlock new realms. Navigate thrilling landscapes filled with surprise obstacles and endless excitement.
